latestAction.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs.

summary.text: This bill designates the facility of the U.S. Postal Service located at 28 East Airy Street in Norristown, Pennsylvania, as the Charles L. Blockson Post Office Building.

title: A bill to designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 28 East Airy Street in Norristown, Pennsylvania, as the "Charles L. Blockson Post Office Building".
